question: What machine learning and deep learning methods are used for RQE?

evidence: The choice of two methods for our empirical study is motivated by the best performance achieved by Logistic Regression in question-question similarity at SemEval 2017 (best system BIBREF37 and second best system BIBREF38 ), and the high performance achieved by neural networks on larger datasets such as SNLI BIBREF13 , BIBREF39 , BIBREF40 , BIBREF41 . We first define the RQE task, then present the two approaches, and evaluate their performance on five different datasets.

title: A Question-Entailment Approach to Question Answering
answer_short: deep learning model and logistic regression classifier
answer_rationale: The evidence explicitly states that two machine learning and deep learning methods—specifically a deep learning model and a logistic regression classifier—are used for RQE. This is confirmed in Text 1 (Section SECREF3) and Text 2, which also mention evaluation across multiple datasets using these methods. Text 3 further supports this by discussing the empirical study of these methods in the medical domain.
